title: Apply for the Small Business Support Grant Bondi Beach December 2025
summary: Find out if you are eligible for the Small Business Support Grant following the Bondi Beach terrorist attack on December 14, 2025.
intro:
Small business owners impacted by the Bondi Beach terrorist attack on 14 December 2025, may be eligible for the Small Business Support Grant – Bondi Beach December 2025.

A Terrorist Disaster Declaration, AGRN 1240 – Bondi NSW Terrorist Attack 14 December 2025, was issued which identified an impacted area.

The maximum amount claimable per application is $25,000.

Each eligible small business is limited to:
who_can_apply: Must be a small business owner impacted by the Bondi Beach terrorist attack on December 14, 2025.
Must have been located and operating in the impacted area at the time of the terrorist attack.
Must have had a valid and active ABN on 14 December 2025.
Must have an aggregated annual turnover of more than $75,000 for the year ended June 2025.
Must have employed less than 20 full-time (or equivalent) staff at that time.
Must provide evidence that the total loss to the business exceeds $5,000.
what_you_need: Evidence that you are a small business.
Evidence that the total loss to your business exceeds $5,000.

faqs.q: What is the maximum amount I can claim?
faqs.a: The maximum amount claimable per application is $25,000.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for this grant?
faqs.a: You must be a small business owner impacted by the Bondi Beach terrorist attack on December 14, 2025. Eligibility requires meeting several criteria, including being registered for GST, having an aggregated annual turnover of more than $75,000 for the year ended June 2025, and operating in the impacted area.

faqs.q: What if I don't meet all the eligibility criteria?
faqs.a: If you do not meet the criteria but can show your business was impacted, you should contact Service NSW to discuss your situation.
